key_insight: Training only on minimal corrections at the first reasoning failure improves instruction compliance while largely preserving untargeted skills.
engineering_relevance: Localized supervision offers a targeted way to shape LLM reasoning without requiring imitation of entire demonstrations.
method: Sample a model completion and identify its first failure under a specified criterion.
Propose a minimal replacement span and supervise only that edited span.
Apply offline or online, adapting online corrections to evolving model failures.
evidence_signal: On ReasonIF with Qwen3-32B, edit-based training substantially improves reasoning-instruction compliance over full-trajectory imitation and trajectory-level reinforcement learning baselines while largely preserving untargeted skills.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliably identifying the first failure and producing an appropriate minimal correction.
paper_title: Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
